doc.brief: The level of granularity for the font selection.
doc.md:
The level of granularity for the font selection.

Depending on this value, the `PangoFontDescription` that
is returned by [`FontDialogButton.get_font_desc()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontDialogButton#method:get_font_desc)
will have more or less fields set.

face.brief: Select a font face (i.e. a family and a style)
face.md: Select a font face (i.e. a family and a style)

features.brief: Select a font and font features
features.md: Select a font and font features

font.brief: Select a font (i.e. a face with a size, and possibly font variations)
font.md: Select a font (i.e. a face with a size, and possibly font variations)
